paite: Judah a mun siangthou ahi a, Israelte avaihawmna gam ahong hita hi.

paite: Tuipi in huai amu a, ataimang a; Jordan lui kiksak in a-omta hi.
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

paite: Tangte belamtal bang in adiang ua, mual neute belampa noute bang in.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

paite: Aw nang tuipi, bang na chi a, na taimang tak? Nang Jordan, bangchi na hia, na kik nawn tak?
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

paite: Nou tangte aw, bang na chi ua ahia, belampa noute bang a na dian uh?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

paite: Nang leitung, TOUPA ma ah ling in, Jakobte Pathian ma ah.
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
